text_block_list.text: In front of the academy gate...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Curren! If it's okay with you, could
we take a
selfie together?
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan

text_block_list.text:
...Ding, ding, ding! ♪ I just cooked up a
super
cute pose, just for youuu!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
W-were you thinking of a pose just for
me?! Wow!
You're amazing! And sooo
cute!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'll treasure this picture
forever!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan

text_block_list.text:
...That was close. I can't let myself slip
like that.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I think Каррен Тян's a little tired from
her
back-to-back races. Maybe I should
revise her
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
